series.name: Stories Beyond the Window
series.description: Godzilla, SHŌGUN, Laid-Back Camp and Dragon Ball: follow familiar stories into the landscapes and towns along Japan’s railways.
series.kicker: From film, drama and manga to places in Japan
series.hook: A familiar story. A different view of Japan.
series.lead: A river from a film. A lake from Rin’s travels. A place where history turned, and a town where a manga artist lived. Take a story with you, and the journey between Tokyo, Nagoya and Kyoto becomes part of the discovery.
series.afterwordBody: You might step off a train to explore a place from a story, or simply remember it as the landscape passes. Either way, there is more to the journey than getting there.
series.zukanLink: Find the views along your route

ui.moreTitle: Where will the next story take you?

zukan.title: Stories Beyond the Window
zukan.description: Godzilla, SHŌGUN, Laid-Back Camp and Dragon Ball: stories that lead to places in Japan.

godzilla.label: Godzilla
godzilla.title: Godzilla in Tokyo: from city streets to the train window
godzilla.hook: Meet him in the city. Remember the scene on the train.
godzilla.deck: Look up in Shinjuku, find another Godzilla in Hibiya, then watch for the river from Shin Godzilla.
godzilla.route: Shinjuku and Hibiya on foot; the Tama River between Shinagawa and Shin-Yokohama.
godzilla.alt: The Godzilla Head above a building at the end of a street in Shinjuku

shogun.label: SHŌGUN
shogun.title: From SHŌGUN to Sekigahara
shogun.hook: A story on screen. A place outside your window.
shogun.deck: From Toranaga to Tokugawa Ieyasu: discover the history behind a landscape on the Tokyo–Kyoto journey.
shogun.route: Between Gifu-Hashima and Maibara by Shinkansen; walk from JR Sekigahara Station.
shogun.alt: Fields, houses and hills around present-day Sekigahara, seen from a Shinkansen

yurucamp.label: Laid-Back Camp
yurucamp.title: Laid-Back Camp around Lake Hamana
yurucamp.hook: See the lake. Find your own detour.
yurucamp.deck: A sunset at Bentenjima, a station beside the water: turn Rin’s journey into a stop along your own.
yurucamp.route: Lake views between Hamamatsu and Toyohashi; detours to Bentenjima, Sakume and Kanzanji.
yurucamp.alt: The red torii-shaped tower at Bentenjima against a sunset over Lake Hamana

dragonball.label: Dragon Ball
dragonball.title: Akira Toriyama’s everyday life in Kiyosu
dragonball.hook: The ordinary days behind extraordinary adventures.
dragonball.deck: Daily calls to a Tokyo editor, manuscripts sent by air: the life and work of Dragon Ball’s creator in his hometown.
dragonball.route: A town beside Nagoya, and a connection to remember when Kiyosu Castle passes your window.
dragonball.alt: The exterior of the BIRD STUDIO office in Kiyosu, photographed in November 2025
